Audit: Identity and Access Management Systems (HID Global)

SEO / AEO / UX review against the B2B buyer journey. Source: unpublished preview (auHash link), rendered 2026-09-30. Keyword data: Ahrefs, US. Recommendations were stress-tested against counter-arguments before being included.

Bottom line. This is a solid category-education pillar with strong research data, but it is not ready to ship and it is aimed at a term nobody searches. Fix the four launch blockers, re-lead with the terms buyers use ("IAM systems"), and give the page a clear commercial path: name the HID products behind each pillar and add one sales-ready CTA. Everything else is second-order.

0. The page isn't live yet

Without the token, the URL returns HTTP 403 "Access denied" (also to Googlebot's user-agent). It is not in the XML sitemap (5,028 URLs checked) and not linked from /solutions. So this is a draft, not a Cloudflare block. Before launch, confirm: 200 to crawlers, no noindex, in sitemap, and language switcher links use clean URLs. Today they point to /de/node/1767?auHash=… and the head emits only one hreflang (en) although 8 locales exist in the sitemap. Body copy is in the initial HTML (good for AI crawlers that don't run JS).

1Clear the launch blockers. All three CTAs on the page have dead links (href="link" twice, href="LINK" once). The checklist form is the literal text “Placeholder for custom Marketo form” beside an FPO image (alt “blue box”). Copy errors: “rely oh HID” and “plus+”. It is the parent topic of both “iam systems” and “identity and access management systems”, so one page can rank for all three. H1: “Identity and Access Management Solutions”. What I'd skip

Hero photography and stat icons; adding more FAQs or more gated assets; rewriting FAQ copy; the OG image; "ungating" the ROI calculators (they're likely your best-converting gated assets); chasing the head term "identity and access management" (KD 28 vs. DR 93–96 competitors); a custom FAQ-accordion rebuild (it's already native <details>).

SERP and AEO context

hidglobal.com is DR 80, so authority isn't the limit; page type is. Winners for "identity and access management systems" are vendor-neutral explainers/listicles (SentinelOne, IBM, Microsoft, Cerbos, Cisco, Splunk, Fortinet) plus Okta's solutions page. HID has 1,174 AI citations across 473 pages already, so a cleaner, answer-first page has a realistic route into AI answers. Realistic goal: top 10 for "iam systems" in 3–6 months, then the primary "identity and access management solutions" (KD 32); longer for "identity and access management systems" (KD 42).

Above the fold

The hero is clean but abstract: the H1 is a label, not a promise, and neither CTA reaches a person. Mobile was not assessed reliably (headless Chrome enforced a minimum viewport); test the 5-item risk tabs and the logo wall on a real device first.

Before you ship: measure

Set a baseline (GSC impressions/queries once live, form conversion, scroll depth to the checklist form, MQL→SQL) so the changes above can be judged. Also confirm the live page isn't noindex, is in the sitemap, and that ?auHash URLs are never emitted in production markup.
